mapper.select: SELECT a.article_id, a.user_id, a.category, a.title, a.content, a.tag, a.url, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.view_count, u.nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_likes al WHERE al.article_id = a.article_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_dislikes ad WHERE ad.article_id = a.article_id) AS dislikeCount FROM articles a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT a.article_id, a.user_id, a.category, a.title, a.content, a.tag, a.url, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.view_count, u.nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_likes al WHERE al.article_id = a.article_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_dislikes ad WHERE ad.article_id = a.article_id) AS dislikeCount FROM articles a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.article_id = #{articleId}

SELECT a.article_id, a.user_id, a.category, a.title, a.content, a.tag, a.url, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.view_count, u.username, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_likes al WHERE al.article_id = a.article_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_dislikes ad WHERE ad.article_id = a.article_id) AS dislikeCount FROM articles a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT a.article_id, a.user_id, a.category, a.title, a.content, a.tag, a.url, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.view_count, u.nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_likes al WHERE al.article_id = a.article_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_dislikes ad WHERE ad.article_id = a.article_id) AS dislikeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.article_id = a.article_id) AS commentCount FROM articles a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN article_likes al ON a.article_id = al.article_id WHERE al.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT a.article_id, a.user_id, a.category, a.title, a.content, a.tag, a.url, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.view_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE article_id = a.article_id) AS commentCount, u.nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_likes al WHERE al.article_id = a.article_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_dislikes ad WHERE ad.article_id = a.article_id) AS dislikeCount FROM articles a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.category = #{category} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
